errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly requested the description to be a single, coherent paragraph. The generated text is broken into four separate paragraphs, which violates the structural requirement and makes the description fragmented.

The prompt requires noting any peaks or dips. The description of the blue line only mentions an overall upward trend, but fails to report the local peak at A2 (1244) and the subsequent dip at B1 (1225).
